name: Siddha Ventures Limited
about: Siddha Ventures Limited engages in the share trading, investment, and broking activities in India. It also invests and trades in quoted and unquoted equities broking or sub-broking services. The company was formerly known as IFB Securities Limited and changed its name to Siddha Ventures Limited in May 2007. Siddha Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Kolkata, India.
